note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; all three castes are present; the difference between tibial spurs 3:2:2 and 2:2:2 as recorded by the original authors is reproduced as it stands; synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule dirty yellow to yellowish brown, antennae, legs and body paler, mandibles dark brown; head and body sparsely pilose. Body length 3.70–4.70 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, broader anteriorly (length including mandibles 2.42–2.74 mm, length to mandible base 1.11–1.32 mm, maximum width 0.95–1.00 mm); frontal projection broadly rounded, reaching the mandible base. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 as long as segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Labrum subrectangular, with 2–3 short setae, anterior margin weakly incurved, with pointed angular projections on both sides (length 0.25 mm, width 0.21 mm). Mandibles slender and rod-like, slightly undulate, apex weakly incurved, slightly longer than head (length 1.32–1.42 mm, left mandible length/head length 1.10–1.19). Postmentum short, rod-like (length 0.32 mm, maximum width 0.27 mm, minimum width 0.23 mm). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior margin distinctly notched (length 0.21 mm, maximum width 0.58–0.63 mm). Tibial spurs 3:2:2, not 2:2:2 as recorded by Roonwal and Verma (1977).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow, antennae, legs and thorax nearly white, abdomen transparent; head and body moderately pilose. Body length 3.30–4.20 mm. Head capsule subcircular (length to mandible base 0.68–0.74 mm, maximum width 0.78–0.79 mm). Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus inflated, rather densely pilose, about half as long as wide, not divided into two halves. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped (length 0.21 mm, maximum width 0.53 mm), neither anterior nor posterior margin notched. Tibial spurs 3:2:2.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head brown, postclypeus paler than head; pronotum pale brown; body yellowish brown dorsally, paler ventrally; antennae and legs paler; wings pale brown, transparent. Head and pronotum moderately pilose, abdomen densely pilose; wing surface with a few scattered short setae. Body length with wings 10.0–11.0 mm, without wings 6.0–7.0 mm. Head capsule subcircular (length to apex of labrum 1.00–1.10 mm, length to mandible base 0.68–0.84 mm, maximum width including eyes 0.95–1.00 mm); Y-shaped coronal suture absent. Fontanelle plate small, circular, situated at the centre of the vertex. Compound eyes circular, distinctly prominent (maximum diameter 0.23–0.25 mm, minimum diameter 0.20–0.22 mm). Ocelli small, oval (length 0.09–0.11 mm, width 0.06–0.09 mm); distance between eye and ocellus half its width (0.036–0.045 mm). Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shortest, segment 4 slightly longer than segment 3 but shorter than segment 2. Postclypeus paler than head, pilose, inflated (length 0.25 mm, width 0.48 mm). Pronotum almost as wide as head, subtrapezoidal (length 0.47–0.53 mm, width 0.89–0.95 mm); anterior margin weakly incurved and shallowly notched, posterior margin convex with a distinct notch. Wings pale brown, with a few short setae and numerous microscales; fore wing length 9.5 mm, hind wing length 9.0 mm; microscales include papillae and both non-stellate (2–6 arms) and stellate (5–7 arms) forms. Tibial spurs 3:2:2, differing from 2:2:2 as recorded by Roonwal and Verma (1977).
